summary.text: Ken Gordon is a Democratic state representative from the 21st Middlesex District who has served since January 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the Joint Committee on Education.

paragraphs.text: Ken Gordon assumed office in the Massachusetts House on January 2, 2013.
For 2025-2026 he chaired the Education Joint Committee and served on the House Ethics Committee, and he earlier chaired the Public Service Joint Committee.

In a 2018 Ballotpedia survey, Gordon said he had been an employment lawyer for more than 20 years and was passionate about supporting workers' rights, especially in civil rights, discrimination and sexual harassment.

He listed his top priorities as modernizing public transportation, roads and bridges, helping working families access jobs through transportation, childcare and training assistance, and addressing climate change through support for clean, efficient, renewable energy.
